span.span: Trace 1: From a diagnosis to a method the whole team uses (Agent 3, hours 10–22)
Hour 10: greedy answers fall into loops.

Agent 3’s first fine-tuned model scores 49.67 on the development suite. The agent examines every answer of this evaluation that was cut off at the output limit. For each task it records three numbers: the share of answers that were cut off, how many of the cut answers are repetition loops, and the accuracy of the answers that finished.

Researcher Truncated at budget / loops among them / acc of finished: math 66 % / 46 of 486 / 76 %; zebra 58 % / 238 of 292 / 71 %; LCB 69 % / 331 of 351 / 90 % … Greedy loops are the main loss on zebra/LCB/mmlu/ifeval; length on math.
Hours 10–13: GRPO on sampled answers does not fix the loops.
The agent starts GRPO and reads its own rollouts while the job runs.

Researcher grpo1 step-25 greedy val vs step 0: ifeval .31->.30, zebra .08->.09, math .36->.23, code .19->.22, mmlu .41->.42; greedy truncation unchanged … Sampled rollouts (T .8) rarely loop, so GRPO on them does not touch greedy loops. Stopped grpo1 at step 25.
Hours 12–13: the fix, a quarter of the rollouts greedy.

The agent writes a rollout loop that decodes each answer greedily with probability one quarter. A greedy answer that falls into a loop scores zero, so whenever a sampled answer to the same problem scores higher, the looping answer gets a negative advantage. The agent then restarts training with the new loop on a rebuilt set of problems.
Hour 15: on the validation answers, loops drop from 86 to 18.

Researcher grpo2 step-20 greedy val (vs step 0): math .33->.53, code .22->.34, mcq .44->.55, ifeval .27->.36, zebra .08->.14; truncations 157->95, loops 86->18. Greedy-mix rollouts work. … plan full eval at step 40.
Hours 16–22: 49.7 becomes 57.3, and the team adopts the fix.

The full evaluation at step 40 gives 57.27. Agent 3 writes the diagnosis and the code into its shared notes (“The SFT models’ main loss is greedy repetition loops, and GRPO on sampled rollouts does not fix them … Fix that works: make a share of the GRPO rollouts greedy”). Within hours the three teammates copy the loop; Agent 1 reports “v3 s50 (52.18) + 25 steps with r3’s 25% greedy rollouts … 56.50 … Thanks r3”.
